source: Authenticated P24 PRODUK response and production /v1/app/produk; read-only audit

formula.FIXED: P24 harga + configured retail fee; P24 fee is not added again
formula.OPEN_AMOUNT: Input nominal + P24 fee_tambahan + configured retail fee
formula.guest_payment_fee: Existing QRIS formula: ceil(subtotal * 7 / 1000); guest gateway remains unavailable without configuration

tests.isolated_database: Passed, including rejected stale total and zero-balance wallet quote without QRIS fee

limitations: Only P24 is an enabled app catalog provider; brands/operators are audited within that catalog.
Price/fee consistency does not prove supplier availability, destination eligibility, fulfillment success, or nominal increments not supplied by P24.
ATF5 and ATF10 have unresolved upstream rejections. Do not describe them as repaired by this pricing audit.
Fixed denomination and upstream cost are distinct; values in product names are not used to invent fees or change upstream request quantities.
